name: Unbridled Necromantic Energy (1-2)
disable: DC 17 Arcana check (trained) to restore some of the arcane wards, DC 20 Religion check or DC 20 Occultism check (trained) to quell the necromantic energy in the room.

items.name: Necromantic Discharge
items.text:
Trigger A creature steps into the room.

---

Effect The necromantic energy pulsing throughout the room branches out like lightning, inundating any creatures in the room or the three squares of hallway outside it. Each creature in those areas must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save save as they are suffused with dark energy, which deals 2d8 void damage, or 2d8 vitality damage to any creature with void healing.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is Enfeebled 1 for 1 hour.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 hour.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 day.

text: Magical energy contained within the room surges in flashes of dark lightning.
